title: Blackstone Joins Nvidia to Mobilize Over $500 Billion for AI Infrastructure
description: Blackstone is partnering with Nvidia and other major financial firms to establish financing platforms aimed at mobilizing significant capital for AI compute infrastructure.

sources.title: Nvidia lines up $500 billion in financing as CEO Jensen Huang tells CNBC his chips are ‘investable asset’
Wall St. Wants Another Half-Trillion Dollars for the A.I. Boom
NVIDIA Partners With Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to Establish AI Compute Infrastructure Financing Platforms to Mobilize Over $500 Billion of Third-Party Capital

sections.heading: Strategic Partnership
paragraphs: According to the NVIDIA Newsroom, NVIDIA has partnered with Blackstone, Apollo, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR. The collaboration aims to establish AI compute infrastructure financing platforms.

sections.heading: Financial Commitment
paragraphs: The NVIDIA Newsroom states that these platforms are intended to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital. Additionally, CNBC reports that Nvidia has lined up $500 billion in financing.

sections.heading: Market Perspective
paragraphs: The New York Times reports that Wall Street is seeking another half-trillion dollars for the A.I. boom. Furthermore, CNBC notes that Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang told the network that his company's chips are an 'investable asset'.

faq.q: Which companies are partnering with Nvidia?
faq.a: According to the NVIDIA Newsroom, the partners include Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR.

faq.q: What is the financial goal of the partnership?
faq.a: The NVIDIA Newsroom reports that the goal is to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support AI compute infrastructure.
